newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on overseas trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended slightly higher against its U.S. counterpart on Monday, reflecting the greenback's weakness overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.625 against Saturday's T$27.631 close.
Turnover through dealers was a moderate US$201 million.
Dealers also noticed mild foreign funds inflow that boosted the local currency. "But the rate will likely stay within a narrow range," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.60-65 range was seen for Tuesday.
